name: Capture Alive (3rd Party – Tricky Owlbear Publishing)
body:
You have learned how to defeat your opponents without killing them.

Benefit: When you deal damage that would kill your opponent you can instead choose to withhold that damage. If the attack is appropriate (GM’s discretion) you can allow your opponent to yield, render her unconscious for 1 hour for each character level you possess, leave a vicious scar, permanently blind her (or only take one eye), or remove an appendage.
